$comment: Tile rendering style measured from the Boda Games The Old Prince punch sheets (artassets/the-old-prince/hexes, 300 dpi CMYK raster). Hex is 520 px flat-to-flat; 'renderer' values are scaled to the shared TileArtwork hex (86.6 units flat-to-flat).

style.description: Hand-inked look on speckled paper: rough-edged near-black track without casing, off-white station circles with a heavy ink ring, white pill revenue badges with bold numerals, black blob town markers on the track, faint tone-on-tone rings or hex outlines marking special tiles. Tile backs are black speckled paper.
style.colorsSource: punch sheets converted through their embedded U.S. Web Coated (SWOP) v2 profile to sRGB
style.colorsNote: Brown-tier tiles are printed dusty rose; gray-tier tiles are pale sage gray. boardColors are sampled from MAP-AUGUST-01.jpg and are what the published tile appearance uses so laid tiles match the preprinted hexes.

specialMarkers.ring: X tiles: tone-on-tone circle, radius 30 units (28.8-31.3), 2.5 wide, markerColors
specialMarkers.hexOutline: T tiles: tone-on-tone flat-top hex at 0.69 of the tile outline (apothem 29.8), 2.7 wide, rounded corners, markerColors

style.texture: fine paper grain plus dark and light speckles across the whole tile; a mid-grey texture can be overlaid at ~8% opacity
